about: How much a statement says: the steps it demands plus the steps it
limits. Nothing to do with whether it can be satisfied.
The two halves are DIFFERENT sets — on a ladder the demand side is
every level above the bottom and the limit side every level below
the top. An implementation that counted one twice would get the same
total on a symmetric case and be wrong everywhere else, so the file
Zero exactly at (bottom, top); maximal exactly at (top, bottom).

coverage.criterion: both extremes, both one-sided cases, a pinned level, and an interior range
coverage.why: one scale only; that the extremes are reached exactly once is asserted exhaustively in the unit tests
